name: Homarylamine
summary: Homarylamine (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methylphenethylamine (MDMPEA) or as METHYL-H, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and methylenedioxyphenethylamine (MDxx) family. It is the N-methyl derivative of homopiperonylamine (methylenedioxyphenethylamine; MDPEA; H). The drug was patented by Merck & Co.

uses.text: The drug was patented by Merck & Co. in 1956 and studied as an antitussive (cough suppressant) in 1961.
